evidence: Defines consensus parameters for BIP 95 (Testnet 5) in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp, activating BIP 54 consensus rules from genesis and eliminating the 20-minute difficulty exception.
rationale: Introduces Testnet 5 to resolve recurring difficulty manipulation and block storms while providing a live testbed for BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules. As noted in the problem statement, 'Earlier testnets suffer from block storms and difficulty manipulation caused by the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule, and there is no public test network enforcing the proposed BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis.' Replacing fragile testnets with an improved network is strategically important for ecosystem testing.
